steps.message:
The push completed — `feature` no longer shows a diverging remote marker, confirming the update landed on origin.

Rebased `feature` onto the updated `main@origin` (fetched first, then `jj rebase -b feature -d main@origin`) and pushed it back with `jj git push -b feature`. Feature's single commit now sits cleanly on top of main's latest state on origin.
